jobs.description_text: ABOUT AIRWALLEX Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full. HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT You’ll lead the technical design, execution, and people leadership for Kai, Airwallex’s AI assistant for complex financial work. You’ll turn rapidly evolving LLM and agent capabilities into reliable, observable, and safe production systems that understand intent, retrieve business context, reason over products and data, and take appropriate actions. You’ll set the technical direction for agent orchestration, context and retrieval, tool integrations, identity and access control, observability, evaluation, and responsible action-taking, while balancing quality, latency, reliability, cost, security, and time to market. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Data, Security, Infrastructure, and domain teams to deliver trusted AI products and reusable platforms that can scale across Airwallex. You’ll manage, coach, and develop AI, backend, and frontend engineers, set clear expectations, and raise the engineering bar through hiring, feedback, and technical mentorship. You'll work from our Singapore office five days a week. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ESSENTIALS - You have 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years leading, managing, or formally mentoring engineers. - You have a track record of building strong teams and delivering complex products end to end. - You have deep experience designing and operating scalable agentic architecture, backend systems, or distributed systems. - You understand the engineering realities of retrieval, model integration, agent workflows, evaluation, observability, and changing model behaviour. - You bring a disciplined approach to evaluation, monitoring, incident management, performance, testing, and operational readiness. - You understand secure software design, including authentication, authorisation, data protection, auditability, and abuse prevention. - You can define and evolve technical architecture across agent orchestration, context and retrieval, tool integrations, identity and access control, observability, and evaluation systems. - You can lead the delivery of production-grade AI features from discovery through launch and iteration. - You can establish product and model success metrics, instrument customer journeys, and use real-world feedback to improve AI usefulness and trustworthiness. - You can build repeatable, versioned evaluation practices for task success, groundedness, tool use, safety, and domain-specific failure modes. - You can define launch criteria, staged-rollout and rollback mechanisms, and monitoring that detects regressions as models, prompts, and data evolve. - You can drive engineering excellence across service design, APIs, data pipelines, reliability, performance, cost efficiency, testing, incident response, and operational readiness. - You can define and improve SLOs for critical AI services. - You can champion robust authentication, authorisation, permission checks, auditability, and human-in-the-loop patterns for agent actions. - You can create reusable agent platforms, developer tooling, quality frameworks, and engineering standards that allow multiple teams to safely ship high-quality AI experiences. - You communicate technical decisions and risks clearly to stakeholders and work effectively with Product, Design, Data, Security, Infrastructure, and domain teams. YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. - You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones. - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. - You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders. - You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM AI at Airwallex is building the path from financial software to autonomous finance. At the center of this vision is Kai, Airwallex’s AI assistant and the intelligent interface to our global financial platform. Kai connects AI with capabilities across payments, accounts, transfers, cards, expenses, and other financial workflows—enabling customers to describe what they want to achieve while the system handles more of the complexity underneath. You’ll build intelligent financial products and autonomous agents that understand business context, plan and reason across multi-step workflows, execute actions within clearly defined controls, and learn from outcomes. The work spans agent architecture, orchestration, context and knowledge systems, ontology, evaluation, governance, monitoring, and reliability. The challenge is uniquely demanding: AI systems are probabilistic, while moving money requires precision, permissions, auditability, deterministic controls, and regulatory compliance. You’ll help define where AI should reason and where financial infrastructure must remain deterministic—turning frontier models into safe, controllable systems that businesses can trust. Join exceptional engineers advancing Kai from assistance to action and, ultimately, toward autonomous finance—where customers define the outcome they want and intelligent systems securely execute more of the work required to achieve it. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full. HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT As a Staff Data Scientist in the Risk Product Data Science team, you’ll lead how Airwallex proactively identifies and mitigates financial crime risk. You’ll work across customer, transaction, behavioural, network and external intelligence data to detect known and emerging risks, uncover suspicious communities and coordinated activity, and improve how we screen customers and counterparties for financial crime exposure. - Build and scale AI-powered risk detection capabilities across name screening, entity resolution, network intelligence and machine learning. - Advance AML and financial crime use cases, including transaction monitoring, detection of coordinated activity, and identification of fraud or financial crime rings. - Partner with Risk Product, Engineering, Financial Crime Compliance and Risk Operations to translate complex risk problems into effective, scalable production controls. - Influence the Risk Product roadmap and raise the technical bar for Risk Data Science through technical leadership, reusable frameworks and mentoring. You’ll work from our Singapore office five days a week. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Essentials - 7+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied AI, Risk Analytics or a related quantitative field, with demonstrated impact at Staff, Lead or equivalent scope. - Strong expertise in applied machine learning and modern AI, with experience building and productionising data-driven solutions at scale. - Experience in one or more areas relevant to financial crime detection, such as NLP and LLMs, entity resolution, information retrieval, graph or network analytics, anomaly detection or risk scoring. - Strong SQL and Python skills. - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior partners across Product, Engineering, Risk, Operations and Compliance. Preferred - Experience in fintech, payments, banking, marketplaces or another regulated or high-risk domain. - Experience in AML, financial crime, sanctions, PEP screening, adverse media, fraud, trust and safety or transaction monitoring. - Experience building or improving name-screening or adverse-media systems. - Familiarity with modern LLM evaluation, prompt and model experimentation, retrieval-quality assessment and AI observability. - Experience applying graph analytics to detect mule networks, collusive behaviour, coordinated account activity or interconnected high-risk entities. - Experience developing proactive risk-discovery capabilities rather than exclusively optimising existing supervised models or rules. YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. - You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. - You over-communicate by design. You'd rather flag something early than let it become a surprise. LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM Risk Platform builds the decisioning infrastructure that sits between Airwallex and every dollar that moves through it, protecting 150,000+ businesses moving over US$260 billion a year across 150+ countries and 60+ currencies, and deciding, often in milliseconds, whether a new signup is real, a payment is safe, or a login is who they claim to be. The hard part is that fraud evolves fast, and every decision carries a two-sided cost: miss an attack and money is lost, over-block and a legitimate business can't get paid. We build this with streaming pipelines processing billions of events a day, graph databases exposing coordinated fraud rings, ML models scoring every transaction, and LLM agents that triage alerts. You don't need a fintech background, just an appetite for adversarial systems problems where the scoreboard is measured in dollars. If you want to help scale one of the world's fastest-growing financial platforms safely, this is the team. APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

You'll own reliable, scalable data solutions end to end while helping raise the bar for technical design and execution. - Design and build scalable data pipelines and data models that power critical use cases across Knowledge Platform teams and business domains. - Partner closely with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders to turn ambiguous data needs into reliable, well-structured solutions that support decision-making and product development. - Own projects end to end, from system and pipeline design through performance, monitoring, and ongoing improvements in data quality and reliability. - Raise the bar on technical design and execution as a senior member of the team, bringing strong engineering judgment, practical problem-solving, and a high standard of ownership. You'll work from our Singapore office five days a week. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ESSENTIALS - Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field. - At least five years of experience designing and implementing scalable ETL pipelines, across batch and real-time workflows, using technologies such as DBT and Spark - Strong proficiency in SQL, database management systems, data warehousing, and data modelling for business intelligence, machine learning, and operational needs. - Strong understanding of data schemas, including star, snowflake, normalised, and denormalised designs. - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform and modern data infrastructure tools, including Databricks and Airflow. - Knowledge of data governance practices, the six key governance pillars, and regulatory requirements in the financial industry. - Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, communication, and collaboration skills, including experience working with globally distributed teams. - Understanding of AI and an interest in applying data engineering and AI in practical and creative ways. PREFERRED - Experience working with data across distributed or multi-datacenter systems, including data migration, duplication, and consistency challenges. - Experience working in financial services, payments, or fintech. - Experience with scripting languages such as Python or R for data analysis and automation. - Certification in data management or related technologies. LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM The Knowledge Platform sits at the foundation of Airwallex’s Data and AI strategy. We are evolving traditional data infrastructure into knowledge infrastructure—turning structured and unstructured information into trusted, reusable context that helps people and AI systems make better decisions and take action. You’ll build the platform end to end, from core technologies such as Databricks, Clickhouse, Spark, and Kafka to real-time analytics, knowledge retrieval and indexing, model infrastructure, agent capabilities, and AI interaction history. You’ll also develop the evaluation, annotation, feedback, governance, permission, and freshness frameworks required to operate AI reliably at global financial scale. Our mission is making this ecosystem truly agent-ready. That means enabling teams to explore data through natural language, investigate business drivers in real time, and give AI systems secure access to the context and capabilities they need to support decisions and execute workflows. If you want to build the foundation that turns Airwallex’s data into knowledge, knowledge into intelligence, and intelligence into measurable business impact, this is where that work happens.
